subject.title: feat: Add local Codex Workspaces analytics

question: Should CodexBar ship this broad local workspace analytics capability as a default-enabled feature in one release, or should its scanner/cache foundation and UI rollout be staged?
rationale: The PR introduces a durable local-data model, new preferences, a replacement/expansion of model analytics, and CI semantics; selecting the permanent product and rollout boundary is maintainer intent rather than a mechanical correction.

options.title: Stage the rollout
options.body: Land the scanner/sidecar compatibility work only after its full-suite and upgrade proof is green, then review the inspector and analytics UI as a focused follow-up.

options.title: Sponsor the full feature
options.body: Keep the feature together, but require the CI-gate correction, a green complete suite, and redacted fresh-install plus upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this branch until a maintainer confirms that local workspace analytics is a current product priority.

recommendation.title: Stage the rollout
recommendation.body: Land the scanner/sidecar compatibility work only after its full-suite and upgrade proof is green, then review the inspector and analytics UI as a focused follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and release-policy context make steipete the best available routing candidate for a feature-scope and rollout decision.
